content: Colorado’s Award Winning DJ Service delivered once again at the wedding of Katie Lee and Michael Robertson! I arrived early in order to set up the sound system and the uplighting. When John arrived, I learned valuable lessons about appearance, timing, and constant communication with the bride and groom. As the night went on, it seemed as if the guests were not feeling like dancing too much, but when we changed the genre of the songs to a latin/ reggaeton feel, the dance floor became occupied again! The reception ended an hour earlier than planned, but things went smooth overall, and everyone was pleased with how the wedding turned out! – DJ Joel Jolly

content: JAMMIN’ DJs has noticed spring has surly sprung at Johnson and Whales University! With finals just around the corner, the student body threw a “Late night breakfast” in honor of the end of the year. Students came piling in promptly at 10PM to get their freshly made breakfast to quickly eat so they can start dancing. About a half hour into eating breakfast, a break-dancer started showing his moves and the dancing didn’t stop until midnight when we had to shut the music off! The biggest hit was the newly famed “Wobble”, everyone making sure they put their own spin on the new hip hop line dance. Fun was to be had at Johnson and Whales University and if you were unable to make the late night breakfast, you missed the event of the year!
